dogecoin.text: @jbarro I only wish that it were Doge Coin...

I'm blessed I'm able to invest my #stimulus. I've a pretty great stock record (buying Apple at $18 in '05 is a highlight), but I felt like being silly & buying #Crypto. I don't trust it, so, why not buy $1400 of the silliest of them all: #DogeCoin?
Bought at .05. It's now .38. 🤷‍♂️

Welp, I made 43% in a year.
I took one of the "stimulus" checks from last year and stuck it in the most ridiculous place: Crypto... but I didn't stop there: I put it in the most ridiculous of the ridiculous: DogeCoin.

I felt stupid doing it, but wise when I sold it today. 🤷‍♂️🤣
